blocks.explanation:
Sines ke jama ko cosines ke jama se divide kiya gaya hai aur jawab \(\tan\alpha\) saabit karna hai.
Chaaron terms ko kholenge; aadhe terms khud hi cancel ho jayenge.
Plan: upar kholo, neeche kholo, common factor cancel karo.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: ek statement.
Saabit karna hai: poora fraction \(\tan\alpha\) ke barabar hai.
Tareeqa: \(\sin(\alpha \pm \beta)\) aur \(\cos(\alpha \pm \beta)\) ke formulas. Jab sum aur difference wale formulas jama kiye jate hain to aksar aadhe terms cancel ho jate hain; yahi is sawal ki chaabi hai.

Numerator kholein
\[\sin(\alpha + \beta) + \sin(\alpha - \beta)\]
\[= (\sin\alpha\cos\beta + \cos\alpha\sin\beta)\]
\[+ (\sin\alpha\cos\beta - \cos\alpha\sin\beta)\]
\[= 2\sin\alpha\cos\beta\]
Kyun: \(\cos\alpha\sin\beta\) ek dafa plus aur ek dafa minus aaya, is liye cancel. \(\sin\alpha\cos\beta\) do dafa aaya, to \(2\sin\alpha\cos\beta\).

Denominator kholein
\[\cos(\alpha + \beta) + \cos(\alpha - \beta)\]
\[= (\cos\alpha\cos\beta - \sin\alpha\sin\beta)\]
\[+ (\cos\alpha\cos\beta + \sin\alpha\sin\beta)\]
\[= 2\cos\alpha\cos\beta\]
Kyun: Is dafa \(\sin\alpha\sin\beta\) cancel hua aur \(\cos\alpha\cos\beta\) dugna ho gaya.
Dhyan dein: Cosine ke formula mein sign ulta hota hai; agar yahan sign ghalat likha to cancel ki bajaye kuch aur bachega.

Divide karein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \dfrac{2\sin\alpha\cos\beta}{2\cos\alpha\cos\beta}\]
\[= \dfrac{\sin\alpha}{\cos\alpha} = \tan\alpha = \text{R.H.S.}\]
Kyun: Upar aur neeche dono mein \(2\cos\beta\) hai, usay cancel kiya (yeh maan kar ke \(\cos\beta \ne 0\)). Baqi sine over cosine, yani tangent.
